randomizationPopulationAndScope.worldSeedScope: Controls 64-bit world RandomSeed / WorldGenSettings.seed across fresh-JVM server launches
randomizationPopulationAndScope.withinJvmFreshEntropy: Sensor.RANDOM, MaidModernPerception.RANDOM, Entity.rand, and arrow spread retain native fresh-JVM randomness (randomSourcesReset=false)
randomizationPopulationAndScope.fixedDesignCovariates: 21x11x9 arena geometry, deterministic target waypoint script, and weapon/ammo initial loadouts are fixed experimental covariates

samplingAndOrderProtocol.conditionalMeanProtocolRequirement: Formal non-preview evaluation unconditionally requires protocol_mode='formal_campaign', pre-sealed os.urandom seed schedule (games_started_at_seal==0), verified server.properties/level.dat/capture worldSeed bindings, verified non-overlapping AB/BA process timestamps, exclusive turbo=1 runtime conditions, and full retention of all attempted blocks

lcbSeparationAndCoverageLabels.singlePointAdmissionVsLcbSeparation: Formal delta_m admission uses single-point predictable aGRAPA wealth K_{m,b}^NI(delta_m); anytime LCBs invert a separate candidate-mean-independent PrPl-EB stake min(c_max/(mu - L_m), lambda_tilde_{m,i}) whose wealth M_{m,b}(mu) is globally continuous and non-increasing on (L_m, U_m] with zero acceptance holes (Waudby-Smith & Ramdas 2024, App. E.4)
lcbSeparationAndCoverageLabels.marginal95Label: marginal_95_anytime_lcb (threshold=20.0, alpha_stake=0.05): per-metric marginal 95% time-uniform lower confidence sequence only; NOT simultaneous 95% across all 17 metrics
lcbSeparationAndCoverageLabels.simultaneous95Label: simultaneous_95_familywise_anytime_lcb (threshold=340.0, alpha_stake=0.05/17): union-bounded 95% simultaneous time-uniform lower confidence sequence jointly valid across all 17 metrics

inferenceMethod.descriptiveDiagnosticsPolicy: Classic unfloored paired Student-t (marked degenerate_zero_variance when sample_sd == 0) and paired block bootstrap are isolated inside descriptive_diagnostics with governs_formal_verdict=false
validityAssumptions: Under single-metric null H_{0,m}, conditional expectation satisfies E[D_{m,b} | F_{b-1}] <= delta_m almost surely wrt historical filtration F_{b-1}
Unconditional physical support D_{m,b} in [L_m, U_m] holds almost surely from game/collector invariants verified prior to statistical evaluation
Pre-committed seed schedule, alternating original/port pair execution order, exclusive turbo=1 runtime, and zero selective block dropping prevent sequential selection bias
finiteSampleLimitations: Under exact distribution-free conditional-mean inference with zero observed differences D_b = 0, information-theoretic minimum blocks is ceil(ln(1/alpha) / ln((-L_m)/(delta_m - L_m))), requiring up to 113 blocks (119 under aGRAPA at c_max=0.95) for [-114, 114] at delta=-3.0
At B=6, 12, 30, 60 with 0 observed regressions, unobserved rare failure event rate has one-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson upper bound 39.3%, 22.1%, 9.5%, 4.9% respectively under i.i.d. Bernoulli trials

Whenever min_m K_{m,b}^NI(delta_m) < 20.0 without hard-gate or futility failure, the evaluator reports INCONCLUSIVE_EXTEND or INCONCLUSIVE_AT_MAX_BLOCKS honestly alongside marginal and simultaneous anytime LCBs
